review.title: Fetch and preview publication to a chosen remote

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Remote chooser is centered and clearly readable over the populated bookmark list. Teal selection and control hints distinguish the slate modal; underlying bookmark cursor remains visible.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: Paired state names the fixture remote and preserves teal bold #65d4cf foreground over #242c3a modal background, with plain bookmark text outside. Selection context remains visible behind the dialog.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Fetch preview wraps the complete command and exact fixture operand within the modal. Run, copy and cancel keys remain visible with adequate spacing; underlying list cursor is still present.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State retains jj git fetch with --remote exact:"fixture", color never, repository scope and all controls. Modal body #e0e6ee and teal controls #65d4cf contrast against #242c3a.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Successful fetch output visibly reports incoming@fixture as new and untracked. The long command header and metadata line run off the right edge before the useful command arguments; output and success state are clear.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State reports Status: success and bookmark: incoming@fixture [new] untracked. Monochrome native output matches color never; clipped command metadata cannot independently reveal the trailing fetch operand.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
pixel_review.summary: Successful dry-run explicitly shows the proposed demo bookmark addition and Dry-run requested, not pushing. Result body is readable, while command metadata is clipped at the right edge.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
text_style_review.summary: State preserves demo [add to 02f7c7e40588] and Dry-run requested, not pushing, with Status: success. Plain output styling is expected for this native remote path; clipped metadata reproduces output visibility issue.

video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; inline full PNGs, paired terminal JSON and sampled MP4 contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: 16 evenly spaced frames across 30 seconds show populated refs, remote selection, held fetch preview, cancellation and reopening, fetched incoming ref, explicit demo dry-run preview and sustained no-push result. Captions and key overlay match the sequence; no fixture setup appears. Paired assertions prove incoming was fetched and remote graph/demo remained unchanged.
